content: The solution is a 3% sterile ophthalmic preparation specifically designed for topical use in the eye. It is classified as a fluorinated carboxyquinolone anti-infective agent. The chemical name of the active ingredient is (±)-9-Fluoro-2,3-dihydro-3-methyl-10-(4-methyl-1-piperazinyl)-7-oxo-7H-pyrido-1,4-benzoxazine-6-carboxylic acid. The concentration of the active ingredient is 3% (3 mg/mL). The inactive components of the solution include sodium chloride and purified water. Additionally, hydrochloric acid and/or sodium hydroxide may be present to adjust the pH of the solution. The solution has an osmolality of 300 mOsm/kg. Ofloxacin, the active ingredient, is a fluorinated 4-quinolone compound. It is structurally distinct from other fluorinated 4-quinolones due to the presence of a six-membered pyridobenzoxazine ring spanning positions 1 to 8 of the core ring structure.
